headline: IndiGo appoints former British Airways chief William Walsh as new CEO
body: IndiGo Airlines has appointed former British Airways chief William Walsh as its new CEO, effective August 3, 2026. This strategic move follows the resignation of Pieter Elbers earlier this month. Walsh, currently with IATA, brings extensive global aviation experience and a customer-focused leadership style to guide IndiGo's next phase of growth and transformation.

headline: OnePlus Nord 6 Camera Configuration, Durability Details Revealed as India Launch Draws Near
body: OnePlus Nord 6 will be equipped with a dual rear camera unit, the Chinese smartphone maker confirmed on Tuesday. The smartphone will carry a 50-megapixel primary camera on the back with a Sony sensor, dual-axis optical image stabilisation, and a multi-focus sensor. The handset will also ship with an 8-megapixel ultrawide rear camera with a 112-degree field of view. On the front, it will feature a 32-megapixel multi-focus camera for selfies and video calls. The company has also revealed that the upcoming Nord 6 will ship with IP66 + IP68 + IP69 + IP69K ratings for dust and water resistance.

headline: Instagram Plus Subscription Reportedly in Testing With Premium Story Tools, Exclusive Features
body: Instagram appears to be testing a paid subscription called Instagram Plus that focuses on enhancing Stories. The feature, spotted by Matt Navarra, is being tested in the Philippines at PHP 65 (roughly Rs. 100) per month with a free trial. It may allow users to manage story audiences, view rewatch insights, extend story duration, and boost visibility through features like spotlight and super hearts. Instagram has not confirmed the feature yet, and there is no timeline for a wider rollout.

headline: Bitcoin Price Hovers Around $67,000; Analysts Say Price Reflects Consolidation Phase
body: Bitcoin traded near $67,000 on March 31 as macro uncertainty and geopolitical tensions kept markets range-bound. Analysts highlighted resistance near $70,000–$72,000 and support around $65,000, with ETF flows showing inconsistency. Ethereum and select altcoins showed mild strength, but overall sentiment remained cautious as investors awaited clearer signals.
